note: Twenty-six pages carry art: 58 measured regions, of which 54 are figure blocks and four are the bands of printed tables. The paper numbers 28 figures and 11 tables, but numbers and blocks do not correspond. Four numbers are printed twice and one four times (18, 19, 21, 23), Figure 8 is skipped, and 'figure 25.' is printed lower case inside the Figure 24 caption line, so eleven printed labels attach to fifteen blocks. Five prose sentences name an exhibit by number; every other caption is a label the text never repeats. Three exhibits are identified by position only: the leaf-bitmap plate runs from p6 to p7 with its 'type 1' to 'Type 4' headings spread over four measured bands, and the p9 and p10 leaf montages carry no number until the Figure 9 line under the p10 pair. Unmeasured: the tail of Table 1 (p13, 48 paths), Tables 2 to 4 and 6 to 8 (p18, p19, p21, p32 - p32 shows 154 paths and no measured region), Table 11, and the unnumbered sensitivity table on p23 (28 paths, no region) - all print as rule-less text with no layout block of their own and are named in the findings rather than invented as rows. Nothing else in the paper is named and unmeasured.
rules: One caption baseline can carry two labels: p5 prints 'Figure 1. NR' and 'Figure 2. LEA' side by side under two 99 pt rasters, so each row quotes only its own half of that line [caption.verbatim].

The prose names five numbers only - Figure3, Figure 4, Figure 6, Figure 7 and Figure 15 - so the other rows keep mention.first_page null instead of borrowing a caption line that happens to sit on the exhibit page [mention.first_page].
Number reuse is the norm here: Figure 18 covers two cases, Figure 19 two, Figure 21 two and Figure 23 four, so a printed number is an attribution aid and never a count [caption.numbering].
A caption printed on the following page still belongs to the artwork above the page break: p17-r1 takes the caption at the top of p18 and p20-r6 takes the one at the top of p21 [caption.position].
Labels skip numbers: Figure 8 is never printed, and a lower-case 'figure 25.' is tucked inside the Figure 24 caption line without ever getting a caption of its own [caption.verbatim].
A labelled grid of separate leaf scans is a composite-panel, not a photo-or-raster image, because every thumbnail carries its own printed file name [geometry.family].
A rendered scene with a ground grid and cast shadows reads perspective-bars, while a MATLAB illumination map reads surface-mesh with a colour bar [geometry.three_d].
A table whose measured band holds only a header and one row is still one table-grid entry, with table.continued true where the body runs past the block [table.continued].

Seven printed tables - Tables 2, 3, 4, 6, 7, 8 and 11 - are laid out as rule-less text with no measured region at all, so the four table-grid entries in this record are a lower bound on the printed tables [table.rule_style].
Section paths stop at the deepest heading printed on the page, so the two p5 sketches carry 2.2.1 while the dendrogram below the heading carries 2.2.2 [place.section_path].

tables.note: variable-definition table: the measured band holds the header row ('Variable name / Corresponding note / Value rage / Physical Meaning') and the SA-Angle row only. The body runs on at the top of p13 with the SD-Angle, Leaf-Index, p-length, LI-Angle and Inter-length rows and the closing note, where p13 shows 48 paths and no measured region, so this block is the head of Table 1 and not the whole table.

classification-result table: the measured band holds the header sliver, the green-filled 'Correct-classified species' row (126 93 90 105 414) and the accuracy row (0.99 0.85 0.88 0.89 0.91). Drawn with fills and no rules.
